name: duml_frame_crc_ok
note: real DUML CRC16 trailer validator (4 callers)

name: duml_resp_send
note: send ACK/response for a received packet (handler tail)

name: fc_api_ctrl_mode_status_request_handler
note: grant/refuse external-control "agency"; gate = mode byte==2, no sender allowlist

name: fc_ctrl_register_requester
note: maps sender->per-device slot via 0x0804748c (0xff=reject), records requester

name: fc_sender_channel_lookup
note: returns slot index for a sender/channel, 0xff if invalid

name: fc_ctrl_gate_mode_read
note: returns mode byte 0x200001d5; ==2 required to grant control

name: fc_ctrl_arbitrate
note: picks active control device by priority predicates; writes gate byte 0x200001d5

name: fc_ctrl_src2_pred_api
note: predicate for device code 2 (API/nav): active iff bit2 of flags 0x200001d6

name: fc_sim_start_handler
note: simulator start/stop/suspend; args initial lat/long/alt (f64) + gps svn; refuse reason 1-6

name: fc_set_rc_lost_action
note: DUML set RC-lost action (payload+0xb, valid {1,2}, else reject 3); stores at +0x1af

name: fc_nav_failsafe_exec
note: main RC-lost/nav failsafe state machine (quits wp/hotpoint/follow, runs go-home/land)

name: fc_sim_cmd_wrapper
note: wrapper calling fc_sim_start_handler; entry in handler-ptr table 0x08043b90
